inputVariables.description: Optional. List of input variables for the api trigger.

trigger.description: Optional. Name of the trigger. Example: "API Trigger", "Cloud Pub Sub Trigger" When set will be sent out to monitoring dashabord for tracking purpose.

outputVariables.description: Optional. List of output variables for the api trigger.

label.description: Optional. The user created label for a particular trigger.

properties.description: Optional. Configurable properties of the trigger, not to be confused with integration parameters. E.g. "name" is a property for API triggers and "subscription" is a property for Pub/sub triggers.

startTasks.description: Optional. Set of tasks numbers from where the integration execution is started by this trigger. If this is empty, then integration is executed with default start tasks. In the list of start tasks, none of two tasks can have direct ancestor-descendant relationships (i.e. in a same integration execution graph).

triggerNumber.description: Required. A number to uniquely identify each trigger config within the integration on UI.

GoogleCloudIntegrationsV2DuetGenerateJav.description: Response message containing generated Javascript code recommendations.

originalExecutionId.description: If this execution is a replay of another execution, then this field contains the original execution id.

enumDescriptions: Replay the original execution from the beginning.
Replay the execution from the first failed task.

replayedExecutionIds.description: If this execution has been replayed, then this field contains the execution ids of the replayed executions.

GoogleCloudIntegrationsV2ExecutionReplay.description: Contains the details of the execution info: this includes the replay reason and replay tree connecting executions in a parent-child relationship

startErrorTasks.description: Required. The set of start tasks that are to be executed for the error catch flow

errorCatcherId.description: Required. An error catcher id is string representation for the error catcher config. Within a workflow, error_catcher_id uniquely identifies an error catcher config among all error catcher configs for the workflow

label.description: Optional. The user created label for a particular error catcher. Optional.

errorCatcherNumber.description: Required. A number to uniquely identify each error catcher config within the workflow on UI.

description.description: Optional. User-provided description intended to give more business context about the error catcher config.

GoogleCloudIntegrationsV2DuetErrorCatche.description: Configuration detail of a error catch task

masked.description: True if this parameter should be masked in the logs

key.description: Key is used to retrieve the corresponding parameter value. This should be unique for a given fired event. These parameters must be predefined in the integration definition.

value.description: Values for the defined keys. Each value can either be string, int, double or any proto message.

GoogleCloudIntegrationsV2DuetTroubleshoo.description: Response for troubleshooting an integration execution.

executionId.description: The execution id of the integration execution to be troubleshooted.

rootCause.description: Root cause of the integration execution failure.

detailedExplanation.description: Detailed explanation of the root cause of the integration execution failure.

errorMessage.description: Error message of the integration execution, if the execution failed.

displayMessage.description: Display message to be shown to the user. Example - If integration execution succeeded, this field value can be "Integration execution succeeded. No troubleshooting needed.".

operation.description: Operation to perform using the configured connection.

referenceKey.description: Referencing one of the WF variables.

EnterpriseCrmEventbusProtoParameterMapFi.description: Field represents either the key or value in an entry.

serviceAccount.description: Optional. The service account used for authentication of this KMS key. If this is not provided, the service account in Client.clientSource will be used.

keyRingName.description: A key ring organizes keys in a specific Google Cloud location and allows you to manage access control on groups of keys. A key ring's name does not need to be unique across a Google Cloud project, but must be unique within a given location.

keyName.description: A Cloud KMS key is a named object containing one or more key versions, along with metadata for the key. A key exists on exactly one key ring tied to a specific location.

gcpProjectId.description: Optional. The id of GCP project where the KMS key is stored. If not provided, assume the key is stored in the same GCP project defined in Client (tag 14).

keyVersionName.description: Optional. Each version of a key contains key material used for encryption or signing. A key's version is represented by an integer, starting at 1. To decrypt data or verify a signature, you must use the same key version that was used to encrypt or sign the data.

locationName.description: Location name of the key ring, e.g. "us-west1".
